title: Case of mysterious medieval skeleton buried in Roman-era sarcophagus at Westminster Abbey finally solved
caption:
For over a century, an ancient Roman coffin at Westminster Abbey puzzled historians because of its medieval lid. Now, newly analyzed skeletal remains have linked the mysterious burial to an Anglo-Saxon abbot from a thousand years ago.

Source: Livescience - Case of mysterious medieval skeleton buried in Roman-era sarcophagus at Westminster Abbey finally solved
